title: I’m the bloody well gigant rolls all them bloody well boulders, bones for my steppingstones. Feefawfum. I zmellz de bloodz odz an Iridzman.
html_source:
A reference to the tale of Jack and the Beanstock, in which giant Jack runs into says:

Fee-fi-fo-fum,
I smell the blood of an Englishman,
Be he live, or be he dead
I’ll grind his bones to make my bread.

which connects with the “I’m the bloody well gigant” line.
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a2Pt5Gyiv50
